criterion.source: sonia_joseph.md l.153-154 (summary of the paper authors' OpenReview rebuttal, https://openreview.net/forum?id=aijGVmEG9Y; the thread itself was not re-read here)
criterion.quote: Asked to define "transition point", the rebuttal introduced a sigmoid criterion: R² > 0.9, inflection ≤ 50% depth, peak ≥ 15 pp above chance
criterion.applied_as: 4-parameter logistic y = lo + (hi - lo) / (1 + exp(-k (x - x0))) in layer index x (points 0..24, post-LN point excluded), k > 0, x0 bounded to [0, 24], least squares with multi-start; fit R² on the sampled points; depth fraction = x0 / 24; chance = R² 0 (every curve here is an R² curve); peak = observed max over sampled points. accept_rebuttal_rule uses 'peak >= 15 pp above chance' as the source words it; accept_rise_variant replaces it with fitted rise (hi - lo) >= 15 pp
criterion.paper_depth: the paper's transition at about one third depth = its layer 8 = our point 9 (frac 0.375); within_1_point_of_paper_depth = |x0 - 9| <= 1
criterion.onset90: stored rule: first sampled point with the curve >= 90% of its max over sampled points

fold_bootstrap.rule: 2000 draws, rng seed 0: resample the 5 fold curves with replacement, average, refit the 4PL; per-fold fits beside it. Only 126 distinct resamples exist for 5 folds, so the CI is coarse

seeds.other: all other RNG seeds are 0 (bootstrap, folds, null draws, shuffles); random-removal controls use seeds 0..n-1
